spans.s: 1. वि—स्पर्धा f. (for 2. See under वि-√ स्पर्ध्) absence of envy or emulation, MW.
2. वि-˚स्पर्धा f. (for 1. see p. 953, col. 1) emulation, rivalry, MBh. (Cf. वि-ष्पर्धस् and ˚धा, p. 1000, col. 2.)
वि-˚ष्पर्धा f. (cf. वि-स्पर्धा) contest for superiority, Vait.
वि—स्पृक्क mfn. (applied to a partic. taste), VarBṛS.
विश्—प॑ति m. the chief of a settlement or tribe, lord of the house or of the people (also applied to Agni and Indra; du. ‘master and mistress of the house’), RV.; AV.; TS.
pl. ‘kings’ or ‘head-merchants’, BhP., Sch.;
, विश्-प॑त्नी. See under 2. विश्, p. 989, col. 2.
विश्—प॑त्नी f. the mistress or protectress of a house (also applied to the fire of attrition), RV.; AV.; TBr.
(accord. to some fr. 2. विश् and पला = पाला) N. of a woman (whose lost leg was replaced by the Aśvins), RV.
(accord. to some, ‘N. of a mare’).
विश्प॑ला—वसु (विश्प॑ला-), mfn. (prob.) kind or friendly to Viśpalā (said of the Aśvins), ib.
(see वि-√ स्पन्द्; prob. w.r. for वि-स्पन्द) throbbing, beating, W.
a partic. dish (prepared from wheat-flour, Ghṛta, and milk), L. (prob. w.r. for वि-ष्यन्द).
वि-˚स्पन्द See वि-ष्पन्द and वि-ष्यन्द.
emulating, vying, envious, RV. (Sāy. ‘free from emulation’), VS.
N. of a Ṛṣi, Br.
N. of a Sāman, ib.
(nom. वि-ष्प॑ट्; fr. √ स्पश्) one who espies, a spy, RV. i, 189, 6.
straits, peril, difficulty, RV.
(cf. विष्फुलि॑ङ्ग below) sparkling, RV. i, 191, 12 (Sāy. ‘a tongue of fire’ or ‘a sparrow’).
(for वि-√ स्पृ; only aor. Subj. -ष्परत्), to tear asunder, separate, AV.
वि-√ स्पृ See वि-ष्पृ, p. 1000, col. 2.
वि-˚स्पन्दित See अ-विस्पन्दित.
वि-√ स्पर्ध् Ā. -स्पर्धते (mc. also P.), to emulate, vie with (acc.; instr. with or without सह or सार्धम्), MBh.; R.; Jātakam.
very clear or apparent, manifest, evident plain, intelligible (अम् ind. clearly &c.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
ind., clearly &c.
वि-स्पष्ट—ता f. great clearness or perspicuity, Sāh.
वि-स्पष्˚टार्थ mfn. having a very clear or obvious sense, Mn. ii, 33.
in comp. for ˚ष्ट.
विस्पष्टी—करण n. the making clear or evident, L.
विस्पष्टी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make clear or evident, Sāy.
